title: X-Men Legends II: Rise of Apocalypse
statusNote: Plays: N-Gage, Activision, Marvel and Barking Lizards logos, a rating screen, title screen, main menu, Single-Player > New Game plays the intro video and loads The Sanctuary; after Xavier's briefing the team of four can be walked around and attacks, and the map, objectives, stats and pause menus open.
notes: The logos at the start cannot be skipped and take about 40 seconds. The title screen then waits for any key.
OK or the left soft key selects in menus. Key 5 skips the intro video and steps through dialogue.
The left soft key opens the pause menu (Resume, Load, Save, Options, Stats, Quit). The right soft key closes the map, the objectives and the stats screen.
Multiplayer needs Bluetooth and N-Gage Arena no longer exists; neither can work here.

controls.source: The game's own Options > Controller screen (its default keys for the ten actions). Moving, attacking, the map, objectives, the stats menu, both soft keys and 5 for dialogue and the video were also tried in play.

actions.5: Attack; next line of dialogue; skip the video
